summary: IsoEnergy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 29, 2026, reporting a wildfire near its Larocque East project in the Athabasca Basin. The registrant voluntarily disclosed an orderly evacuation of field personnel and a temporary suspension of exploration activities due to dangerous conditions advised by the Saskatchewan Public Safety Agency. Three contractors remain to operate protective sprinkler systems. The filing is a routine operational update and does not involve any corporate transaction, capital return, restructuring, or strategic review. It is not a special situation.
